notes.text: Hyman cites 66a. The linked occurrence is on 67b, where Rava bar Ḥaklai asks Rav Huna about a courtyard opening into an enclosure.
Ḥaklai is a conventional vocalization of חקלאי. The notice lists Rava bar Ḥaklai without further identification.
